cases.note: Rank-2 Gaussian fit on UNCENTRED data (trait means 0.5, -0.3, 0.2, 0.8, -0.6, 0.1; sha256 checked); R: value ~ 0 + trait + latent(0 + trait | unit, d = 2, unique = FALSE) converged with a positive-definite Hessian; same optimum (logLik within 1e-6, asserted in the test). The R values are far from zero (smallest |value| about 0.058) and pairwise distinct, so a constant or zero implementation fails. The postfit batch fixture these rows replace was row-centred (R values ~1e-14). Compared elementwise by value; the R names (traitt1, ..., traitt6) are asserted equal to "trait" * trait name in the test, Julia's coef is unnamed.
